inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.description: Collect ideas, decide together, and build your colour palette.
inspiration.startEditor: Boards are like folders for ideas. Pick one to start with. You can rename it any time.
inspiration.startViewer: No boards yet. Once the couple adds some, they’ll appear here.
inspiration.tipAll: Tip: drag a pin onto a board above to move it.
inspiration.tipBoard: Tip: drag a pin onto a board above to move it, or onto another pin to change the order.

board.hint: Boards group your ideas, e.g. Flowers, Dress, Tablescape.
board.name: Name
board.deleteText: {count, plural, =0 {The board is deleted for everyone.} one {Its # pin, comments and uploaded images are deleted for everyone.} other {Its # pins, comments and uploaded images are deleted for everyone.}} This can’t be undone.

shareDialog.off: Link turned off. The old link no longer works.
shareDialog.title: Share “{name}”
shareDialog.text: Anyone with the link can look at this board (not change it), e.g. your florist or hairdresser. They don’t see comments or anything else in your wedding.

add.title: Add pins
add.text: Upload your own photos, save an image from any website, or discover ideas.
add.skipped: Some files were skipped: only JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 10 MB (20 at a time).
add.uploadFailed: Couldn’t upload {name}. Is file storage set up (see README)?
add.added: {count, plural, one {Pin added} other {# pins added}}
add.uploadHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB each. Only your wedding team can see them.
add.addressHint: A web page (we’ll find its main picture) or a direct image link.
add.cantShow: That image couldn’t be shown. Try a different link.
add.setupText: Discover searches millions of free photos on Unsplash. To turn it on, whoever runs this app adds a free Unsplash access key as UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY (the README explains how). You can still upload photos and save links.
add.noPhotos: No photos found. Try other words.

lightbox.details: Details, colours and comments for this pin.
lightbox.deleteText: It’s removed from the board for everyone. Uploaded images are deleted too.
lightbox.title: Title
lightbox.notesPlaceholder: What do you love about it?
lightbox.tagsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. peonies, blush
lightbox.noColours: This website doesn’t let us read the image’s colours. Try an uploaded or Unsplash image.
lightbox.addToPalette: {count, plural, one {Add # to palette} other {Add # to palette}}

linkErrors.notUrl: That doesn’t look like a web address.
linkErrors.protocol: Only http and https links work.
linkErrors.port: That link uses an unusual port.
linkErrors.status: The site answered with an error ({status}).
linkErrors.notImage: That link isn’t an image or a web page.
linkErrors.noImage: We couldn’t find an image on that page. Try right-clicking the image and copying its address.
